description: Synchrony Financial is a premier consumer financial services company delivering one of the industry's most complete digitally-enabled product suites, whose experience, expertise and scale encompass a broad spectrum of industries, including digital, health and wellness, retail, telecommunications, home, auto, outdoor, pet and more. It has an established and diverse group of national and regional retailers, local merchants, manufacturers, buying groups, industry associations and healthcare service providers, referred to as its partners, and it connects its partners and consumers through a dynamic financial ecosystem, providing them with a diverse set of financing solutions and innovative digital capabilities to address their specific needs and deliver seamless, omnichannel experiences, utilizing a broad set of distribution channels including mobile apps and websites, online marketplaces and business management solutions like point-of-sale platforms. Its offerings include private label, dual, co-brand and general purpose credit cards, as well as short- and long-term installment loans and consumer banking products, and during 2025 it financed $182.3 billion of purchase volume, and at December 31, 2025 it had $103.8 billion of loan receivables and 70.7 million active accounts.
